response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_avg_hgb FROM Laboratory), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), above_average AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall_avg_hgb FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg_hgb) SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb, a.avg_hgb - a.overall_avg_hgb AS above_overall_avg, a.avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM above_average) AS above_group_avg FROM above_average AS a ORDER BY above_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
